devin: Hey @maria-peopleops — quick Q about the company shutdown week. I'm a contractor in APAC and my contract only shows 5 PTO days. My local statutory holidays fall during the shutdown; can those be converted to a floating day or paid out? Trying to book travel.

maria-peopleops: Short answer: maybe. Contractors are governed by their SOW/contract and payroll rules. We can request a one-off alignment or payout, but it requires manager sign-off + payroll cutoffs. Please don't book until approved. :wave:

devin: got it. What's the process?

maria-peopleops: Steps you should follow:
1) Open People Portal -> Leave Exceptions -> choose "Holiday Alignment/Conversion"
2) Attach your contract and a list of dates you want converted
3) Your manager (cc @ryan-mgr) needs to approve the request
4) People Ops will confirm payroll cutoffs and choose either "floating day" or "payout" based on employment type and local regs

Here's the minimal info we need (you can copy/paste into the form):
```
Name: Devin Patel
Role: ML Contractor (3rd party)
Region: APAC - India timezone
Contractor SOW ID: SOW-7821
Requested conversion: 2 days (Dec 24, Dec 27) -> floating day or payout
Reason: statutory APAC holidays overlap company shutdown week
Manager: Ryan Chen (ryan-mgr)
```

ryan-mgr: Devin — I can approve this if People Ops confirms payroll can handle payout or float. Devin, please submit the portal ticket and I'll approve same day. :thumbsup:

peopleops-bot: New exception request submitted: EX-2024-9981 (status: pending manager approval)

ashley-hr: Payroll note: cutoff for year-end payouts is Dec 15 for the Dec payroll cycle. If request comes after that, we can only offer floating days (subject to contract) or a Jan payout. For contractors paid via vendor invoices, vendor agreement matters — we may need vendor sign-off.

jamal-contractor: tagging to confirm — I'm in a similar boat. If it's converted to float, does that use up our 5 PTO bank or sits separate?

maria-peopleops: Good Q — for contractors we treat converted statutory days as separate "company shutdown days" where possible. If contract allows, we mark them as unpaid statutory alignments or grant 1-2 floating days. They don't automatically reduce your 5 PTO unless the contract says so. We'll check SOW-7821.

devin: submitted EX-2024-9981 and attached SOW. Pinged @ryan-mgr to approve. Thanks all.

peopleops-bot: Manager approval recorded by ryan-mgr at 1923456810

maria-peopleops: Devin — I see the portal entry and Ryan's approval. Payroll needs your preferred option (float or payout) by EOD Dec 10 to hit Dec payroll. Reply here with "float" or "payout" and we'll route. If no reply we'll default to floating day. :calendar:

devin: float please.

maria-peopleops: Got it — marking EX-2024-9981 as "float approved" and updating your leave balance. I'll DM you the confirmation and the calendar entry once done. Thanks for flagging early.

jamal-contractor: thanks — helps to see the workflow.

maria-peopleops: Always happy to help. If anyone else in APAC needs mass alignment, tell your manager and we'll batch requests to payroll to avoid multiple cutoffs. :slightly_smiling_face:
